import{useState,useEffect,useCallback}from'react';export const useChat=function(chatRoom){let config=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:{};const{storageKeyPrefix='chatMessages',canSwitchRooms=true,availableRooms=[]}=config;const[messages,setMessages]=useState([]);const[loading,setLoading]=useState(true);const[currentRoom,setCurrentRoom]=useState(chatRoom||'default');const[canSwitch,setCanSwitch]=useState(canSwitchRooms);const[currentUserAuthor,setCurrentUserAuthor]=useState('');const[isRecording,setIsRecording]=useState(false);const[mediaRecorder,setMediaRecorder]=useState(null);const[recordingTime,setRecordingTime]=useState(0);const[recordingInterval,setRecordingInterval]=useState(null);// Определяем текущего пользователя и права доступа

else if(demoRole==='user_2'){setCanSwitch(true);}},[]);// Получаем ключ хранилища

const initialMessage={id:1,author:'Админ',content:getWelcomeMessage(room),timestamp:new Date().toISOString()};setMessages([initialMessage]);localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify([initialMessage]));}setLoading(false);},[getStorageKey]);// Инициализация
